_note: ADR-058 §D3 VERIFY-FIRST CLAUSE. These are the real, recorded PostToolUse envelopes Claude Code sends on stdin for a Bash tool call — captured live on 2026-07-27/28 by registering a temporary debug hook (matcher Bash, PostToolUse) in a scratch .claude/settings.local.json and driving three headless `claude -p` sessions that each ran a real Bash command. Fields verified real, not guessed: tool_name, tool_input.{command,description}, tool_response.{stdout,stderr,interrupted,isImage,noOutputExpected}, tool_use_id, duration_ms, session_id, transcript_path, cwd, prompt_id, permission_mode, hook_event_name. This satisfies the ADR's mandate that the shape be captured from three real envelopes before any parser is written.
_uncaptured_failure_case: REPEATED, VERIFIED FINDING (5 independent attempts: plain `false`, `false` mid-sequence between two successful calls, a stderr+exit-1 compound command, and `ls` on a nonexistent path — twice, once with a bounded stdin read and an invocation marker written BEFORE reading stdin at all): a Bash tool call that exits NON-ZERO never invoked our PostToolUse hook process at all (the invocation marker file never appeared) when driven via `claude -p` (sdk-cli entrypoint), Claude Code v2.1.220. A parallel PreToolUse debug hook fired reliably for the exact same failing command, proving hook loading/dispatch works in general and the gap is specific to PostToolUse-after-a-Bash-error in this entrypoint. This is reported as a measurement, not a verdict (Rule 22/23): it may be specific to headless/-p/sdk-cli sessions rather than true interactive usage, and is NOT asserted to hold in a normal Claude Code session. Consequence for this design: the git-push SUCCESS path (which the whole feature depends on) is unaffected, since success-exit Bash calls fired PostToolUse reliably in every one of the 3 captures below. The 'catch a failing gh/vercel/netlify/npm-publish command directly via the observer' behavior is therefore built defensively and treated as best-effort/advisory ONLY — never the source of truth for a CI verdict, which is always scripts/signal-watch.mjs's poller (gh run list), matching the ADR's own 'advisory, never blocking' framing for W1.
